nodes.label: Full Repository Review
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: Senior architect + security audit review. Overall score 6.7/10. System is locally runnable but NOT production-ready. Critical issue: fresh production DB deploy broken due to Alembic migration bootstrapping gap. One CRITICAL bug fixed: UserRead.email EmailStr rejecting .local TLD emails.

nodes.label: Next.js 14 Frontend
nodes.rationale: Next.js 14 frontend. Clean build, TypeScript passes, cookie-based auth. Frontend permission gates via hasPermission() and hasModule() in AuthContext.

nodes.label: Alembic Migration Chain
nodes.rationale: 80 migration files. CRITICAL: base migration ALTER TABLE sales_orders on a table that doesn't exist in fresh DB — Alembic was introduced after initial schema existed. Fresh production deployment will fail. Fix: prod_bootstrap.py with create_all() + stamp head guarded by BOOTSTRAP_PRODUCTION flag.
